title: TurnCompleted
description: A turn finished. It is what closes the turn in the UI and what carries what it used and, when the engine says, what it cost.

outcome.description: How the turn ended — never the engine's own name for it (ADR-025). `completed` is the only one `usage`/`costUsd` describe a turn that actually ran to the end; the other three still carry whatever the engine reports for them, which a crash may leave zeroed. A subtype the adapter does not know is `failed`.

promptedBy.description: Who sent the prompt this turn answered.

usage.description: What the turn used, in our names (plan 28, B-29) — each count present only when the engine reports it; an empty object when it reports none.

cacheReadTokens.description: Input tokens read from the cache.

cacheWriteTokens.description: Input tokens written to the cache.

reasoningTokens.description: Tokens spent reasoning, when the engine counts them apart (plan 28, D-17).

webSearches.description: Web searches the turn made, when the engine counts them (D-17).

costUsd.description: Cost of the turn in US dollars, as a decimal string — absent when the engine reports no cost (`capabilities.cost: none`). Zero is `"0.000000"`, never absent. A string and not a number because money through a float is money that rounds where nobody looked.
